card.name: Inside enzyme and mutation codes
card.fires_on: Partway through enzyme, drug-target and mutation names, just before a final digit or number, such as the 4 in I47V, the 3 in PDE3 or the hyphen in DPP-4. Seen in CYP and P450 names and in viral resistance mutation lists.

modes.label: Enzyme names
modes.description: The piece in the middle of an enzyme or target name, just before its final number.

modes.label: Hyphen or letter before number
modes.description: A hyphen or letter inside a code like DPP-4, DP-5439 or CYP2B6.

modes.label: Mutation codes
modes.description: A digit inside an amino-acid mutation like I47V in a list of resistance changes.

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a following digit or letter that finishes a technical name.
card.plain: It fires inside enzyme and mutation codes when the last number or letter is still to come.
